items.text: Not every "I don't want medical anymore" reason points to the same exit.

items.heading: IT Is One
items.text: IT is one of the largest non-medical destinations for PCB students in India, and also the one most often oversold as "no math needed at all.".

rows: PCB students who want a direct, non-math-gated route into software without an engineering entrance exam.
Most BCA programmes accept any stream with around 50% in 12th. The math you skipped in school still shows up as logic and discrete-math coursework, budget real effort for it, not none.
Self-taught path into development (bootcamp or self-study plus projects)
Students confident they can build discipline without a structured degree pushing them.

A computer science degree is not a hard requirement for many entry developer roles; hiring managers increasingly weigh a working portfolio and demonstrated logic over the credential. But nobody hires "I like coding", they hire shipped projects.
IT-adjacent roles (QA, business analysis, IT support, product operations)
Students who want tech-industry income without becoming a hands-on coder first.
Lower entry bar than pure development, but the ceiling depends on how much technical and analytical skill you add over the first two to three years.

items.heading: Name the Actual Gap, Not
items.text: Name the actual gap, not the whole subject. Most PCB students do not need "all of 12th math", they need probability, basic algebra, and logical reasoning. Naming the exact gap makes it solvable in weeks, not years.

items.heading: Use a Structured Foundation Course
items.text: Use a structured foundation course before jumping into the degree material. A short, focused statistics-and-logic foundation course (many are free or low-cost) before your first semester saves you from drowning in week three of a data science or bioinformatics programme.

items.heading: Practice on Real, Ugly Data
items.text: Practice on real, ugly data before you touch a textbook problem set. Clean, one small real dataset (a school attendance sheet, a local shop's sales log, a public government dataset) using basic spreadsheet or Python skills. This builds real comfort faster than solving isolated math problems.

items.heading: Pair the Technical Bridge
items.text: Pair the technical bridge with one visible output. A small dashboard, a short data-driven writeup, or a simple working script is worth more to an admissions panel or an employer than a certificate that only says you completed a course.

items.heading: "Without Neet" Is Not
items.text: "Without NEET" is not the same question as "other than medical.".

items.heading: A Pcb Student Can Avoid
items.text: A PCB student can avoid NEET and still spend a career inside health systems.

items.heading: A Pcb Student Who Wants
items.text: A PCB student who wants out of medicine entirely needs a genuinely different map, engineering, data, IT, forensic science, agriculture, business, and more.

items.heading: Both Are Legitimate Questions
items.text: Both are legitimate questions. They just lead to different lists of options.
